The '''Ryoone campaign''' was a [[Standard month/Legends|month]]-long string of engagements fought on [[Ryoone/Legends|Ryoone]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==The campaign==
After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Churhee's Riflemen]] continued to fight the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] with the support of the [[New Republic Army]].<ref name="GAW" />

This collaboration had its most celebrated [[Propaganda/Legends|public exposure]] during a [[Standard month/Legends|month]]-long string of engagements on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ryoone/Legends|Ryoone]]. During the campaign, Churhee's Riflemen fought against the Empire's [[Lightning Squadron/Legends|Lightning Squadron]].<ref name="GAW" />

==Aftermath==
After the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|captured]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Churhee's Riflemen no longer felt comfortable working for those in the seat of galactic power. The Riflemen returned to [[Turcan III]], where they had fought their greatest [[Battle of Turcan III|battle]], and once again began hiring themselves out as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] company.<ref name="GAW" /><ref name="AJ15">{{JournalCite|15|Special Military Unit Intelligence Update}}</ref>
